lame.min.js is lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), a JavaScript port of LAME (https://lame.sourceforge.io), used unmodified under the GNU LGPL.
It is loaded only when publishing songs to the public gallery.
soundtouch.js is SoundTouch JS 0.3.0 (https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS), a JavaScript port of Olli Parviainen's SoundTouch, used unmodified under the GNU LGPL 2.1.
It is loaded only when you set a song's PITCH or REVERSE in the effects strip (it pitch-shifts a preview copy; your saved song is never changed).
